facts.fact: Max 在写作冲刺结束的计时声中敲下 The End，完成了新恐怖小说 Crashing Echoes。
facts.anchor: type the two words that make every writer’s heart flutter—The End.

facts.fact: 挚友 Cathie 点破：Max 笔下反派的死法写得太末世，她心里住着严重的愤怒。
facts.anchor: there’s some serious rage living in that head of yours.

facts.fact: Max 拒绝 GrimmCon 大会登台，坚持用笔名 Max Usher 保住匿名，哪怕 Reddit 传言她是男人也不澄清。
facts.anchor: There’s a reason I write under a pen name. I like my anonymity the way it is.

facts.fact: 编辑 Lauren Kaplan 带来消息：出版方要把 Crashing Echoes 的上市提前到今年秋天（万圣节档期）。
facts.anchor: we think we can move the release up to this fall.

facts.fact: Lauren 劝她做签售和个人曝光换销量，Max 顶回去：不做签售、不上晨间节目、不办巡回，只为安宁。
facts.anchor: I won’t be your show pony just to improve your bottom line.

facts.fact: 电梯里拆开本月邮件，一个盖着 Fairhope 邮戳的白色信封让她全身肌肉瞬间绷紧。
facts.anchor: one envelope catches my eye—it’s plain, white, and unremarkable, but its postmark makes every muscle in my body tense.

facts.fact: 信封里是 Fairhope 高中 2016 届十周年同学会请柬；Max 当场在电梯里恐慌发作，爬出电梯冲上街头。
Lauren 当面点破 Max 因创伤把自己与世界隔绝，劝她别再躲。
facts.anchor: You’re an exceptional woman. Don’t deprive yourself of meaningful experiences because of your trauma.

facts.fact: 心理师 Dr. Roberts 把同学会重新定义为机会：给你九个月准备，自己决定要不要回家。
facts.anchor: Nine months to prepare yourself. Nine months to decide whether you’re ready to go home.

facts.fact: 结尾 Max 口头答应「Maybe」却是撒谎，内心发誓地狱结冰也不可能回 Fairhope。
facts.anchor: Hell has a better chance of freezing over than me ever going back to Fairhope.
